title: Heat-health dual-pipeline review
goal: A systematic-review reader can see databases and other sources merge into one screening pipeline.

rubric.must: Separate database and other-source identification boxes visibly feed the PRISMA flow.
The database removals and 1,400 screened count visibly reconcile.
The reports-sought, not-retrieved, and full-text-assessed counts visibly reconcile.
Visible side boxes list exclusion reasons and totals.
The final box visibly reports 50 studies and 54 reports.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies both blockers and all three remaining requirements with explicit counts and exclusion reasons, while the picture omits the numerical reconciliation.
